notes.Dates: Printed as MM/DD/YYYY ('07/24/2026', etc.); normalized to ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) here, consistent with every other date field in this schema. This is an AWS-managed blueprint (water-and-sewer-bill) whose field descriptions instruct MM/DD/YYYY - not ours to edit - but since these are single-value (not list) date fields, extraction-compare's normalizer resolves BDA's MM/DD/YYYY to the same calendar date, which now counts as an exact match.
